description: We are speedo igniters from Grade 9 TVS academy Tumkur we are here to design the health care web app to astronauts in space
summary: ASTROCARE AI, developed by Team SPEEDO IGNITERS from TVS Academy,Tumkur, is a space healthcare platform for monitoring astronaut health. It includes health assessments, AI analytics, NASA research exploration, hazard analysis and medical support guidance. It addresses spaceflight health challenges and communication delays, supporting safer long-duration space missions and future human exploration.
details: ASTROCARE AI, developed by Team SPEEDO IGNITERS for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, is an integrated astronaut healthcare platform designed for long-duration space missions. It includes a mission control dashboard, health self-assessments, camera and image inputs, voice check-ins, an interactive human body explorer, spaceflight hazard analysis, NASA research data exploration, AI-powered analytics, medical support guidance, health routines and downloadable reports. It also demonstrates Earth–Mars communication delays and store-and-forward messaging. The platform helps astronauts monitor health indicators, understand space-related health risks and organize information for medical support, contributing to safer future human exploration of space.
